selection.conditions: AND; learned facts and flags from relationship snapshots, counts/recency from aggregate journal, effective events supplied explicitly
selection.group_conflict: reject entire group if any participant already assigned

clock.suppression_expiry: day-index wrap at 10AM; not display midnight

source_reconstruction.origin_precedence: sort project map IDs, then placement IDs; first authored NPC placement wins. If none, first resolvable move target in participant steps. Source Edric origin town placement (704,528), not target civic foot (688,528).
source_reconstruction.startup: create component with origin.mapId/origin.point; start directed routine with reconstruct=true
source_reconstruction.seek_load: cancel all affected actors and release occupancy first; restore logical origins; register origins belonging to loaded map; restart with explicit initialMapId and reconstruct=true
source_reconstruction.ordinary_reassignment: keep component current logical feet/map; reconstruct=false; do not replay elapsed window
source_reconstruction.elapsed: after start, advanceRoutine(elapsedWindowSeconds) only if reconstruct and elapsed >0
source_reconstruction.executor: resolve all move targets at start; initial loaded occupancy failure is typed; validate directed portal route before unloaded goal resolution; loaded actors walk to first source door; source then directly resolves final offscreen target; finite update bound steps.length+1024
source_reconstruction.cancellation: executor cancel clears cursor/path/action/speech but does not directly release occupancy; world reconstruction releases explicitly
source_reconstruction.known_failure: INT-064 still Pending; enum/cause unknown. Hidden town Edric and absent home rest reported; source tests read are not a reproduction.
source_reconstruction.target_adaptations: root owns safe single materialization and rollback; release reservations in every lifecycle path; hold actual feet and atomic leases; validate each directed leg; avoid unchanged restarts; bounded 64 transitions/actor, 512 total proposed, no per-day replay or reward replay

movement.target_policy: capsule-aware nav/occupancy and achieved animation; no visible catch-up snap, phasing, attacks or infinite repath

dialogue.entries: eligible current-step, routine default, ordinary; allowDialogue=false blocks
dialogue.group: lease loaded participants before overlay; apply directive while leased then one reconciliation on close
dialogue.jump_effect: one-time npc-02-archive-lead-shared flag plus participant-scoped ledger jump; preserve existing social transaction ordering

save.new_minimal_facts: allowlisted authored active world events and current authoritative day suppression; no further durable fact found
save.reuse: conversation memory, event aggregates, weather forecast, manual-save ownership
save.excluded: position/path/cursor/timer/lease/speech/occupancy/animation; no offline progression or autosave; strict current schema only
